records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6-day-old Starter account with no project, no invites, no tickets, and no customer reply to either outreach email [email:89a630c5], [email:1b32e808]. A getting started call was held 4 days ago [calendar:311ff1a3] yet nothing followed, suggesting low momentum; 8 days remain, so some chance but modest.

draft.subject: Following up after our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. Since then I wanted to check in on where things stand on your side.

When you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through setting up that first project with you \u2014 just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
